en: I already sent one girl down there,
That uh, what's her name?
...Well, bum-tiddly-dumpkins, I forgot that too.
But I'm sure you'll find 'er!
I think she said she were gonna be around that there Nature Center.
Checkin' in to see what kinda help she needs is prolly a good step one.
So whaddya say, you up to bat too?
RANDALL: Now that's what I like to hear, partner!
Good speed to ya.
I'll be around if'n ya need the reminder.
RANDALL: Nah?
Well ain't that a pity.
Guess we'll have to call in the shortstop or what have you.
That's how baseball works, right?
But I'll be here if'n you change your mind. You just let me know.
RANDALL: Multiple Anemones have been sighted around Route 1 and the Aventurine Woods.
I already sent what's-her-face down there to check it out, so mosey on down to the Nature Center and see what kinda help she needs!
RANDALL: How do you hat-tippin'ly do, partner?
Maybe better than some folks up north near Labradorra.
Them folks've put in a report about a certain critter hustlin' all through Victory Road.
No sign of one them... what's it called...
Anon Monies?
Yeah, that sounds right.
No confirmation of Anon Monies yet, but you never can be too careful.
You fixin' to hit it up?
RANDALL: Good on you, trooper.
The reports have all come in from the west end of Victory Road-- that is, the one near Labradorra City.
Best you start your searchin' on that side, I'd wager.
RANDALL: That's a right shame, friend.
I'm sure those Anon Monies must be worth a pretty penny...
RANDALL: Need some refreshment?
Got reports of a whatchamacollit runnin' around Victory Road.
They've all come in from the west end of Victory Road-- that is, the one near Labradorra City.
RINGMASTER: Hi, \PN!
After having not one, but two of these ragtag little gremlin creatures' shenanigans affecting my circusing endeavors, I've decided I live here now!
If anything else goes wrong, I'll at least know about it.
And hey-- who knew remote management could be so practical?!
Speaking of remote management, we're getting some kind of reading in a pretty remote location lately.
Namely, the Mirage Tower.
It's faint, but definitely there.
Apparently it's submerged somewhere?
Or at least that's what the guy with the whatchamacollit says-- I don't know how all that works.
So, what do you say for your next act, you get out to the Mirage Tower and investigate?
And look for somewhere underwater.
Does a place like that even exist there?
It is the desert, after all...
Anyway, I'll be here if you need any support, or just want to notify me of hazards flying into my circus.
Come to think of it, I guess that was how we met...
I heard the Mirage Tower is tied to the oases in the desert.
Maybe you can do something there to make it appear if you need?
RINGMASTER: Here's a change of pace for you-- security detail.
So some of the others around here have apparently been practicing a music act on the side.
I think it's a relatively new thing, but they've wasted no time in setting up a first show.
Sort of a charity event type thing from what I understand?
It's taking place over at the restored Blacksteam Shelter, and they've got a final rehearsal today.
Here's the problem--
For a little while, we've had inconsistent energy readings from that area, and it's gotten worse recently.
They asked if I wouldn't be able to send someone over just to keep an eye on things in case something goes south now or during the show.
There's no reason anything should happen during the show, but...
...Well, let's be honest; something's going to happen.
That's just how it is, you know?
It's like if the dress rehearsal is a disaster, everything's gonna be fine.
But if it goes off without a hitch? That's when you start sweating.
Are you up to go make sure they have an awful dress rehearsal?
RINGMASTER: Great!
I'll tell them you're coming.
Just head over to Blacksteam; I think they're meeting in the big room on the first floor.
RINGMASTER: Listen, I think I phrased that badly.
I just mean to help out when there are inevitably problems...
RINGMASTER: Some of the others are rehearsing for a charity show at Blacksteam Shelter.
There's been some inconsistent energy readings for a while, so they want someone else around-- just in case.
And there will be a case.
Cuz, I mean-- that's show business.
Meet up with them in the big room on the first floor of Blacksteam Shelter, but expect the worst!
SIMON: Newest emergency on deck.
You know the meteor?
As in THE meteor?
It may have been found.
And where that is, there's a chance Lin is there as well.
Ciel and Samson have gone to scout it out, but we're rallying more backup if it becomes necessary.
You'd make a good vanguard as always too.
The meteor was found in a New World gate inside Citrine Mountain.
In case the worst is afoot, it may be best to hurry.
SIMON: The meteor may have been found.
Ciel and Samson went to scout it out already, but they could be in desperate need of back up.
It'll be from a New World gate inside Citrine Mountain.
Godspeed.
RANDALL: New shindig, friend. This one comes to you from Beryl Cave.
'Parently there's some kinda temple what appeared over there.
Folks are suspectin' there may be another Astronomy in there.
A few of the Jim Leaders already went out to give the once over,
But don't worry, you can call them James Leaders.
Reborn James Leaders.
Yup, that sounds official.
Anywhoosit, you wanna back 'em up?
RANDALL: Radical, friend. You dig those shins.
Beryl Cave, same Beryl as in Beryl Ward, ya heard it?
Yeah, I'm sure James Reborn has it covered,
Whoever he is.
RANDALL: Gotta go meet James Reborn over at Beryl Cave.
Some kinda temple, they say.
MARCELLO: Hi, want to buy some lemonade?
MARCELLO: Anyway, there's a thing in the desert.
We don't sell directions here.
But if we did, I'd tell you to take the train from Grandview station, and then follow the tracks north until they disappear.
Then move right until you find the door.
And then I'd tell you to fix it!
MARCELLO: There's a thing in the desert.
Like the middle of the desert.
And a little bit to the right.
No, I can't be more specific.
Just fix it.
It's driving away the customers, so go fix it.
MARCELLO: The rainbow menace went to the desert!
This happened because you didn't fix it!
There was a thing in the desert and I asked you to fix it and you didn't fix it.
Go fix it and also fix the rainbow menace!
Also buy some lemonade!!!
ACE: So this is where all you little heroes have been camping out in all this time!
I've got to say, I quite enjoy the spectacle!
Where all life is but a precession of stimulation, a bit of smoke and mirrors do a lot to light up our nights!
If what all we know is constrained solely to our experiences, then is illusion truly delusion,
Or was it just a memory made special for us?
Make some fine memories, little hero!
Some days, they're all we have.
ACE: Ah-- \PN, a moment of your time.
Back at that awfully chilly New World--
Certainly a rather... frigid and unpleasant place to wake up in my own right mind to.
But perhaps, it is the company I kept that made the spectacle all the more tolerable.
I hadn't the chance before to express my thanks truly and properly for rescuing me from that predicament of its own.
It is admittedly still difficult to remember all the details before I came to.
Ah, but why dwell on matters out of our own hands?
I'd simply wanted to find the time to thank you from the bottom of my heart for rescuing the little prince as you did.
I had enough lucidity at the start from the box I was in to save ZEL from Magnezone's explosion, but--
I-- I-I'd never quite lived out my own nightmares in reality as I did when I bore witness to his fate in that Steel Leader's Gym, and...
ACE: ...Well, all I can say is that I have never been more grateful as I am now.
...For you, and for his safe return.
ACE: Trouble with a disappearing dragon, was there?
You know, I always did think it was a bit queer,
The wasteland packed more whimsy and pizzazz than you could punt a whiffle at.
Why would that be?
Some kind of Legendary force just living out there?
Something real that no one could see?
Things like that-- they're always in such a way that someone must be trying very hard to keep them hidden.
It is perhaps surprising that someone of my persuasions didn't see through the ruse sooner!
Ah, but if we could see all of life's illusions with just a glance, then what would be the point of looking at all?
It does this performer a spot of good to be outmaneuvered!
Still, all for the best for you to still the beast.
And don't bother asking something silly like how I would know what happened.
Didn't I ever tell you?
I can read minds, you know!
ACE: Still finding all those antagonistic Anomalies out there, are you?
I've heard quite magnificent tales of all the magic you've mustered on your journey!
Ah, you needn't be shy about it, little hero!
Why, what's the gain of embarrassment?
Only to dim a spectacular show!
You've committed an admirable amount of splendor amongst all your adventures-- but even then, what is any adventure but another stepping stone to the stars?
Let yourself shine-- the stars will thank you themselves, to see another among them!
ACE: By the by, I understand you picked up a little friend down in the Water Treatment Center!
And I know you won't do something silly like ask how I know that!
I was perhaps, wondering...
May I see the little one?
ACE: ...Hm? That doesn't seem to be the little one I remember...
ACE: You're still quite small, aren't you, little one?
ACE: You're growing stronger under \PN's care, aren't you?
ACE: Ah, you're all grown up, little one!
I'd missed seeing you dearly.
It was a bit of a rushed job, you see-- the circumstances hadn't exactly permitted me any different.
I'd hoped that it wouldn't be too lonely in there.
...Perhaps you and I aren't so different in that regard, hm, little one?
I count myself grateful that you're in more than capable hands now.
And to you, \PN--
ACE: You may consider your debt of paying it forward as fully imbursed already!
If this little one helped you step forward at any part of your journey between saving the world and freeing me, then it is a miracle play in my book!
And if it didn't...
Well, no accounting for taste, I suppose!
Do take care of each other anyway, won't you?
ACE: Ah, understandably so.
Perhaps I could ask another time.
ACE: Pick a card, any card!
Ah, of course!
I knew you'd pick the 'Yes' card!
I knew you'd pick the 'No' card!
It was written all over your face.
Now I'll simply spin it around twice like so, and--
ACE: Voila!
The card has completely changed color!
You may keep it, as a souvenir!
ACE: ...That really was the end of the line, wasn't it?
I must be honest, I might find myself missing the excitement of it all.
...Minus the danger, that is.
Any chance to remedy any prior ill will or to merely enjoy the presence of those dear to me is gratefully accepted.
Still, you are, as always, deeply appreciated.
You know, little hero,
If you ever find yourself not wanting the magic to end,
Or perhaps you'd like to make some of your own?
I'll let you in on a little trick of my own, with love--
You might be familiar with this one~
But guard it with caution!
A magician must never reveal their secrets~
The next time someone asks you for a password, you might try and tell them "mintyfresh"!
And perhaps teach me a little of your own magic while you're at it, hm?
ACE: I can't help but feel just the slightest bit out of place among all of your allies, little hero.
Though some are my own friends too, to have truly resolved any conflict is as magic as I've ever managed to muster!
ACE: If you ever have need of strength, I'm sure any of these other strapping Trainers will readily back you up.
Ah, but if what you need is a smile?
Then you know who to seek out.
ACE: Ah, I can see it in your mind!
What you're thinking-- hoping-- looking for right now--
It's...
Unique dialogue!
Alas, we're fresh out; so sorry!
ACE: You're a part of my family too now, little hero, don't you know?
Truly-- for every bit of magic you've managed, you have my deepest gratitude and admiration!
ACE: Someone asked me recently if I should get new cards now that Team Meteor is meeting no more.
A fool I may be, but 'twas a foolish inquiry!
Team Meteor may be but a crater in the ground, but their memories are still my home.
Those who remain are still, even now, my family.
I could not ask for a more powerful deck.
LIN: Welcome, \PN.
ADRIENN: What are you doing here?
We've already--
\PN has already defeated you!
LIN: You were quite generous to show that boy here.
I thank you for that,
Since he, in turn, showed me.
ADRIENN: What are you talking about?!
LIN: He is beyond incompetent, but his victim act must be quite compelling.
Everyone is so quick to give into crocodile tears,
But when they come to the jaws of the beast, they act surprised.
LIN: I think we'll be seeing each other a lot more from now on.
After all, we have the same goal.
LIN: All we have to do is get it from her.
Candy from a baby.
Flowers from a grave.
Isn't that right?

My protocol states that you are here to Theme Team.
Well, guess what. We have LOTS of theme team.
So you're gonna have to pick.

Pick a trainer, pick a team matched to a special challenge field, and FITE.
Ok, go.
Do you want to select your opponent yourself or should I choose someone random to wipe the floor with you?
Not enough trainers available at the moment.
CASSBOT: The Teams will now Theme. Proceed.
CASSBOT: I see you are winner!
I also see your opponent just blew herself up.
Interesting choice, to blow herself up.
But you can do better than that.
We'll save the BP for a real battle.
Here, have a BP or whatever.

Okay bye.

CASSBOT: Hello, I am REAL Cassbot.
That other Cassbot is FAKE.

Would you like to boss rush?

Get out of here. I am a busy robot.

Get in.

Wait until all of the leaders are around, and then you can boss rush.

LIN: uh.
hi?
NYU: Haihaihai, \PN!
I heard they'd give me foodstuffs if I helped out here so I'm pretending to do work right now.
Hey, do you wanna go do it for me?
I won't share my food but I will share my love.
???: Haihaihai, random person who just walked up to me!
We didn't meet in a different file or anything, right?
My name is better left unsaid, but if you must know, I am Sir Elyvilon Nyunyunyu Esq. III.
You can just call me Nyu~
Technically I created Reborn's PC server system-y stuff, but I prefer to think of myself as just a simple Pikachu.
Anyway you're here because you wanted to help out, right?
NYU: Oh, it's you again~
Did you bring food this time?
Or did you just want to hear about the thingy?
Lately there have been some earthquakes in the Chrysolia region...
Huh, didn't that happen before?
Well, if it was a really big Pikachu that caused them before,
It's probably a really big Pikachu causing them again~
Sooooo we need someone to go down to Chrysolia Forest and poke around until we find what's causing them this time.
I think someone said something about hearing train noises there too?
But maybe the Pikachu just got hungry and ate the train for lunch.
That can't be healthy... Trains are so oily.
Were we talking about something?
Oh, will you go find that Pikachu for me?
Super sweetness~
If you look for train crumbs in Chrysolia you'll probably find it eventually, maybe.
And remember, when in doubt: Eat it!
But I don't wanna...
A really really big Pikachu ate a train somewhere in Chrysolia, maybe.
Maybe it also didn't eat it and just made train sounds?
Or maybe the Pikachu is a train?
Maybe it's just training to reach a higher level?
I don't remember...
Hey, do you smell muffins?
Mmmm, mollycoddling muffins~
NYU: Haihaihai~
Recently, there've been some reports of multiple Pikachu swimming underwater within Ametrine Mountain.
They're probably not hurting anything there, but it's a Pikachu,
So someone should probably go check on them~
One person already went...
Um, what's her face, with the glasses~
But since there's more than one Pikachu, it probably makes sense to send more than one human!
D'you wanna go too?
NYU: I'm sure you're in for a spicy adventure!
It'll be somewhere underwater in the greater Ametrine area--
I think someone said something about looking for Ametrine B1F?
Probably?
Or maybe not.
Even Pikachu have to breathe sometimes.
NYU: Oh, well. That's fine too~
NYU: There've been some reports of multiple Pikachu swimming underwater within Ametrine Mountain.
so someone should probably go check on them~ One person already went...
She'll probably be fine even if you take a while though!
I'm sure even now, she's camped out, having a nice, tantalizing picnic,
Featuring such delights as the boisterous biscuit!
And serendipitous sammiches~
Hey, hey, bring me back a sandwich, would you?
RANDALL: Hang onto your knickers, partner-- we've got a big one.
Reports are saying that people were seeing one of those Animes up on the Wasteland Wall.
You know, the one that divides Chrysolia and Byxbibsixthshypsixsion?
But get you this...
The 'Mon they said was in the Anime?
Mewtwo.
Yeah-- I didn't believe it either.
But I think some folks are gonna be wantin' to jump on this Anime right quick.
You one of 'em?
RANDALL: You got it, partner.
Get in there and show that Anime who's what and what's who!
RANDALL: Leave it to the little people, eh?
Sure is generous of you to give the others a chance at an Anime as powerful as that one first...
RANDALL: There's were some reports of an Anime spotted up on the Wasteland Wall.
Thems says it was a Mewtwo!
The wall is between Chrysolia and Byxbuxbaxbexbestbysinthewestsion.
But just betwixt you, me, and the ol' ragged fencepost, I reckon you'd have an easier time gettin' up there from the Chrysolia side.
Done some exploring around there myself, don't you know?
Look hard on that one.
Good luck, partner!
NYU: Haihaihai again, \PN~
Today, I have a special invitation just for you!
No Pikachu today, but some of the others are having a special picnic!
I don't remember their names, but it was a bunch of the kids!
And they told me I should invite you~
Like as a cherubic chaperone type of thing?
NYU: Sweetness~
They said they were gonna try and find a good picnicketty spot over in Rhodochrine Jungle.
Maybe near that tree?
I wish I could go too,
But I don't wanna intrude, and it's okay because secretly I'm hiding all my snacks behind this desk anyway.
You have fun~
NYU: Wait, you don't want to go on a picnic?
Where you sit outside and eat things?
I don't understand?
NYU: Some of the others are having a special picnic!
But why picnic near there?
It's not like you could eat the tree, right?
It's not like a gellatinous juniper,
Or a crunchy confier,
Or the splendiferous spruce.
It's just a tree?
Then again, you don't have to let that stop you.
When in doubt, eat it!
NYU: So I heard that a Pikachu ate all the color from your picnic...
I don't see this as a problem, but I guess we gotta protect the pretty colors.
So anyway you need one 100% organic Zygarde to continue the picnic?
I'm not here to judge anyone's dietary choices, but I don't think those cells cook well...
Well, when in doubt, eat it!
ASTER: Change your mind? Or just need a refresher?
ASTER: \PN.
Good to see you again.
I know the feeling may not be mutual, but I'm just here to do my part.
Clean up the mess I helped to make. You know?
Maybe make her proud.
Forget about it, all right? We've got a mission.
So there's a few reports coming in from around Route 4, right?
Several portals opening. Anomalies. Weird weather patterns.
We need someone to get up there and check it out.
Our equipment's reporting three different portals from the look of things, so you might need to really dig through Route 4.
You good for it?
ASTER: Like a plan, then.
I'm around if you need a reminder, back up, or anything else.
ASTER: No pressure.
...It's not cuz of me, is it?
Mission referesher?
There's reports coming in from Route 4.
Get up there and check it out.
SIMON: Hello, \PN.

Like many of the others here, I've decided to make good on the forgiveness that's been offered to me and show up to see what help can be offered in the aftermath of my former associates' poor choices.
...Well, and mine too.
It's been a while since we spoke.
Please rest assured I've long since left Team Meteor and their ideals behind.
Even before their destruction, I had already been distancing myself from their activities...
I've come here to offer what little help I can in the wake of my former associates' subsequent disasters.
I hope you can find comfort with that.
Let's focus on business.
SIMON: Let's check the report.
Apparently a boy in Agate City was going for a swim in the creeks throughout town and found something.
A portal hidden underwater, below the city.
I believe it's the place that Lin took that sacred stone from.
No sign of any Anomalies yet, and fortunately the kid had the good sense not to explore further,
But someone's gonnna need to go check that out.
It's even possible that the stone itself will somehow turn up, as its whereabouts have been unknown since Lin had it.
Should I mark down that you're on the case?
SIMON: Copy that.
Best of luck out there.
And might I say, it's good to be on the same side as you rather than against.
SIMON: Can't do everything all the time; I understand.
SIMON: Apparently there's a portal below Agate City.
It should be hidden underwater, where Lin took that stone from.
ASTER: We got a mission, boss.
You remember Aegir Cave-- where you and Bennett found that Victini?
Turns out there might be more to it.
There's a pretty big energy reading from somewhere deep beneath that cave.
We need someone to go down there and check it out.
You that someone?
ASTER: Copy that, boss.
Remember, the way to that cave is through the west end of Victory Road.
Bit forward, through the New World, and then you're there.
Once you're in the cave, I suggest looking for the lowest point possible.
Might even be underwater.
You can do it, boss!
ASTER: Always could be someone else.
Always could be later.
No sweat, boss.
ASTER: There's an energy reading far below Aegir Cave, where you found that Victini.
The way to that cave is through the west end of Victory Road.
SIMON: Good to see you again, \PN.
There's a new report today-- an unusual one.
No sign of Legendaries, no portals, no anomalies...
...But I think you'll agree that it is a matter of immediate concern that, uhm.
Apparently that teacher down at Apophyll Academy-- Kiki?
She's back.
She's been holding sermons regularly for a little bit now.
Victoria only just found out herself and headed out already.
But I've got a feeling someone might wanna check on her.
SIMON: All these people coming back to life...
It feels wrong to hope that maybe what I worked towards wasn't wrong.
That it'll still pan out...
But it was always a devil's bargain.
If it never comes to pass... that is probably for the best.
ASTER: New mission, boss.
This one comes as a request for back-up from Bennett.
The Belrose sisters trucked off to the Mirage Tower out in Tourmaline for some good, old-fashioned family bonding time.
...Or at least as old-fashioned as hunting Legendaries in New World space can be.
But some he-said, she-said--
Apparently Laura had some concerns about the other two getting moody.
Not entirely sure what's up with them, but he wanted someone to go check on them to make sure nothing's getting out of hand.
